description: Which script produced each figure, from which inputs, to which outputs.
notes: Public extract of the analysis-host provenance audit. Absolute paths, host names and confidential directory names were stripped. Figure-level confidence is copied as recorded; UNRESOLVED and MEDIUM rows are not upgraded.
Public fields: figure_id, in_article, script, input_files, confidence, status, unresolved_reason. Input names may refer to confidential tables; only the filename is shown.

Confidence is HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW or UNRESOLVED as defined in confidence_definitions. Dataset data_status=verified means the extract was built from a real audit file, not that every figure link is settled.

confidence_definitions.HIGH: On-box script writes the exact current filename; listed inputs exist; script and PNG mtimes agree within about five minutes on the same day.
confidence_definitions.MEDIUM: On-box script is the named generator. Inputs exist or are the script's declared paths. Script vs PNG mtimes disagree, or rebuild is blocked.
confidence_definitions.LOW: Only a historical script name is pointed to by another file; that script is absent on the analysis host.
confidence_definitions.UNRESOLVED: No on-box script writes this filename. No link was invented.
